sloka: सन्नह्य तु ससुग्रीवः कपिराजबलं महत् ।कालज्ञो राघवः काले संयुगायाभ्यचोदयत् ।। ६.४१.२४ ।।।।
transliteration: sannahya tu sasugrīvaḥ kapirājabalaṁ mahat ।kālajño rāghavaḥ kāle saṁyugāyābhyacodayat ।। 6.41.24 ।।।।

translations.english: Climbing down the mountain, the righteous Rama reviewed in his mind the strength of his army and the enemy which is difficult to assail.
